name: io.github.payware/mcp-server
title: payware
description: payware A2A payments API for merchants, ISVs, payment institutions and buying agents

environmentVariables.name: PAYWARE_PARTNER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Partner role: merchant, isv, payment_institution or payer (a buying agent, no keys needed)

environmentVariables.name: PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Partner ID from the payware dashboard (not needed for the payer role)

environmentVariables.name: PAYWARE_SANDBOX_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the RSA private key for the sandbox (not needed for the payer role)

environmentVariables.name: PAYWARE_PRODUCTION_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the RSA private key for production

environmentVariables.name: PAYWARE_LINKS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Payer role only: the base URL of the public link host, e.g. http://localhost:8080 for a local payware server. Defaults to https://go-sandbox.payware.eu (sandbox) or https://go.payware.eu (production)

environmentVariables.name: PAYWARE_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load, e.g. products,placements. Unset loads every tool. Toolsets: auth, transactions, products, placements, data, logs, poi, shops, onboarding, utils, payer
